events.title: FOMC hikes 25 bp to 3.75–4.00%
events.why_it_matters: Unanimous first hike since 2023, citing still-elevated inflation, resets the discount-rate path for equities, credit, housing, and the dollar.
events.what_to_watch: October 7 minutes for dissent/dot-plot color and whether markets price another hike by year-end.

events.title: White House memo to restrict Canadian goods in U.S. federal procurement
events.why_it_matters: Directs OMB/USTR to identify and, where lawful, remove Canadian-origin items from federal civil procurement in retaliation for Canada's Buy Canadian barriers, hitting a WTO GPA market the White House pegs above $280 billion.
events.what_to_watch: FAR/OMB implementation steps and any Canadian countermeasures in provincial or federal tenders.

events.title: EDVA unseals Google ad-tech remedies (behavioral, no breakup)
events.why_it_matters: Judge Brinkema rejected AdX divestiture but ordered six-year interoperability, data-sharing, AdWords non-discrimination, and a monitor—material for GOOGL and the open-web ad stack.
events.what_to_watch: Joint proposed final judgment (due early October) and whether DOJ appeals the no-breakup outcome.

events.title: H-1B $100,000 entry restriction extended 12 months
events.why_it_matters: Proclamation extends the $100k H-1B payment through Sept 21, 2027 and a same-day EO tightens interagency scrutiny, raising labor costs for IT outsourcers and large tech employers.
events.what_to_watch: DHS national-interest exceptions, DOL prevailing-wage final rule, and FY2027 cap/consular volumes.

events.title: Trump–Xi Washington summit extends U.S.–China trade truce
events.why_it_matters: Leaders extended the trade truce to Jan 10, 2027 (including BIS 50% affiliates-rule suspension) and sketched limited tariff relief/~$30bn each way plus coal purchases, cutting near-term tariff and export-control cliff risk.
events.what_to_watch: Written tariff lists, rare-earth talks, and whether the affiliates rule is extended again before the new January deadline.

events.title: BIS temporary rule restricts polysilicon stockpiling
events.why_it_matters: Commerce/BIS temporary final rule (Proclamation 11052) limits importer stockpiling of polysilicon and derivatives ahead of Dec 4, 2026 import adjustments, a supply-chain hit for solar and semiconductor inputs.
events.what_to_watch: Waiver criteria, new-importer limits, and the Dec 4 adjustment details.

events.title: Costco Q4 FY2026 beat; cites IEEPA tariff-refund EPS tailwind
events.why_it_matters: Q4 EPS $6.75 and +9.4% comps confirm consumer resilience; a +$0.15 tariff-refund item is a live marker for how IEEPA refunds flow through retailers.
events.what_to_watch: Membership trends, FY2027 warehouse openings, and whether peers guide similar tariff-refund benefits.

events.title: FTC/states settle Corteva pesticide loyalty-rebate case
events.why_it_matters: 10-year ban on share-based distributor loyalty programs plus $35 million to states should open generic crop-protection share and pressure Corteva pricing; Syngenta case continues.
events.what_to_watch: Court entry of the stipulated order and any Syngenta settlement or trial dates.

events.title: China State Council orders stronger counter-cyclical support
events.why_it_matters: Li Qiang meeting pledges faster bond issuance, 'six networks' project starts, timely monetary tools, and property-stabilization measures to hit 4.5–5% 2026 growth after 4.7% H1.
events.what_to_watch: PBOC relending/LPR follow-through and actual special-bond/project commencement prints.

events.title: JOLTS job openings (August)
events.why_it_matters: First major labor print after the Sept 16 hike; openings near ~7.2–7.3 million would test whether the labor market is still tight enough to keep the Fed on a hiking path.
events.what_to_watch: Openings vs 7.27 million July, quits rate, and any downward revision into Friday's payrolls.

events.title: BEA Q2 GDP third estimate and August PCE
events.why_it_matters: Same-morning GDP (2nd estimate was 1.5% annualized) plus the Fed's preferred PCE gauge is the first inflation/growth check after the hike.
events.what_to_watch: Core PCE MoM/YoY versus July's +0.2%/+3.3% and any GDP revision away from 1.5%.

events.title: Micron FY2026 Q4 earnings
events.why_it_matters: AI memory bellwether guided ~$50bn revenue and ~$31 non-GAAP EPS; print/guide will set HBM/DRAM pricing expectations across semis.
events.what_to_watch: HBM supply commentary, gross margin vs ~86% guide, and FY2027 capex/pricing.

events.title: FCC votes on satellite spectrum unlock and NEPA rewrite
events.why_it_matters: Open meeting would free >1,000 MHz (12.7 GHz and 42 GHz) for FSS and codify that most spectrum/space authorizations are not NEPA 'major federal actions,' accelerating satellite broadband buildout.
events.what_to_watch: Final vote text, earth-station/space-station exclusions, and Ku/Ka/D-band FNPRMs.

events.title: Nike Q1 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Global consumer/wholesale bellwether (consensus ~$0.44–0.45 EPS, ~$11.3bn sales) will signal demand, China, and inventory after a tough apparel cycle.
events.what_to_watch: North America/China comps, gross margin, and FY guide.

events.title: September employment situation (NFP)
events.why_it_matters: First payrolls print after the hike; August was +162k / 4.1% U3, so a miss or wage surprise would immediately reprice the extra-hike odds.
events.what_to_watch: NFP vs ~160k, unemployment rate, and average hourly earnings.

events.title: FOMC minutes of the September 15–16 hike meeting
events.why_it_matters: Three-week minutes will show how close the Committee was to 50 bp vs 25 bp and the conditions for another hike, with no SEP at the Oct 27–28 meeting.
events.what_to_watch: Inflation-risk language, labor-market assessment, and any discussion of financial conditions after the 25 bp move.
